answer: My answer to sybils is Driving instructor permit with transport authority attestation — a permit number in the transport register — which makes the meadow of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Fakes fail here because a permit number in the transport register is tied to something outside the network; the haven of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the orchard of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
